messages:
sam: Quiet window reminder 22:00-02:00 UTC. Small cross-svc release tonight (api/runtime/console/router). Need owners + rollback snippets in-thread.

deploy-bot: Window scheduled. Runbooks RB-421 + RB-422 linked. Ack and paste rollback cmds.

chen: Runtime owner. Pin rwinference:2.4.0-canary, start 3% then ramp. Watch KV miss and GPU OOMs. Runtime rollback: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-image rwinference:2.3.8 --immediate`.

julie: API owner. Schema change behind feature-flag scoped to canary. API rollback: flip flag back and remove canary route (curl ready at T-5).

maria: Router owner. I'll shadow then 1%->5%->20% header-split. Router rollback: `rtrctl set --route header-split --version v0.9.2 --reason "rollback"`.

sam: Rollout order: runtime canary -> router shadow -> api flag -> console gate. Rollback triggers: p95>2000ms for 5m, 5xx +5ppt, KV miss +20%.

ops-oncall: Creating #ephemeral/deploy-1767777000, hooking p95/5xx/KV-miss alerts, paging on Sev2. 15m post-100% watch.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK: infra checks green, images and console build present. Start at 22:05 UTC to allow staging. If thresholds hit call rollback, ping @ops-oncall + @deploy-bot.
